title: Is PMBOK Guide the Right Fit for AI? Re-evaluating Project Management in the Face of Artificial Intelligence Projects
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Ethical Considerations' as one of the five core features of AI projects that necessitate a re-evaluation of project management standards. It dedicates a substantial section (IV.E) to ethical analysis and provides a specific table of tailoring recommendations (Table 5) addressing morals and ethics, including bias, fairness, and accountability.
